shortDescription: Three z-levels (sky/surface/basement) in ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling/needs/work/storage come free from vanilla. V1 deleted; per-frame cost cut 80% and verified by measurement. Publishes as a new mod.
body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 (42.6k LOC / 156 files) has been **DELETED**, with one rescue (see §3). Everything below describes the only architecture that exists now.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`, so the column behaves as one big map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. THE ARCHITECTURE

One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`. Bands stack along **+z**, each a contiguous `CellIndices` range. `band = surfaceBand + level`; bottom-to-top = basement / surface / sky. An impassable, permanently-fogged **gutter** separates bands.

**`Slot` is rounded up to a multiple of 64** (250-high band → slot 256, gutter 6). Load-bearing: RimWorld terrain shaders sample from WORLD POSITION, so a non-aligned vertical offset makes identical terrain render with a different texture phase in the see-below view.

### The one insight everything rests on
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Two spatially distant regions that share a `RegionLink` are adjacent as far as RimWorld is concerned. Both ends are `RegionType.Portal` (the stair is a `Building_Door` subclass), and `Portal` fails `ShouldBeInTheSameRoom`, so the link **conducts connectivity without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum**.

`Reachability.CanReach` is managed region-BFS, so it works unpatched — and that transitively fixes `ClosestThingReachable`, `RegionTraverser`, storage search and **every `WorkGiver_Scanner`**.

**PROVEN in-game:** a colonist hauled steel out of a SEALED chamber joined only by a synthetic `RegionLink`, with zero hauling code written.

### The dividing line
| Class | Outcome |
|---|---|
| **Graph / logic** — reachability, storage, work scanning, hauling, needs, reservations | **FREE** |
| **Geometry / presentation** — LOS, range, targeting, path lines, ghosts, projectiles, labels, selection | **NOT free.** Every 2D-cell-space computation must be told |

Each geometry surface is corrected **at its own draw/compute site**. Do NOT patch `Thing.DrawPos` globally — the see-below renderer prints below things at real positions then translates emitted vertices, so a pre-localized DrawPos double-shifts. (That trap was V1's `DrawPosOffsetPatcher`, now deleted.)

### Hard 1.6 constraints
- The pathfinder is **jobified** (`PathFinderJob` : `IJob` over `NativeArray`; `PathGridJob` : `IJobParallelFor`). A* neighbour expansion is **not patchable**. All custom traversal lives at `Pawn_PathFollower`. `PathRequest.ValidateInt` gates on `pawn.CanReach`.
- `PathFinder` has **no `FindPath` method**; the managed surface is `FindPathNow` + `PathFinderTick`. Harmony cannot see inside the Burst job, so **pathfinding cost is only measurable end-to-end (wall clock)**.

---

# 2. WHAT'S BUILT (`Source/`, ~7.1k LOC)

**Core (shared tier, `Source/Core/`)** — `ABMod`/`ABLog` · `ABGuard` (per-subsystem kill switches; a failure disables one subsystem silently, so check guard state when a feature "just stops") · `ABDefOf` (3 terrain defs + 1 mesh flag) · `ABSettings` (9 fields, V2-only) · `ABGameComp` · `ABGameHooks` · `ABBlame` · `ABPawnCooldown` · `HarmonyBoot`.

**Core model** — `ABBandMap` · `ABBands` (allocation-free CWT-cached facade) · **`ABWormhole`** · `ABWormholePather`.

**Generation** — `ABBandedGeneration` · `ABSkyBandGen` · `ABRockOreGen` · `ABMapSizeLimit` (200×200 cap).

**Renderer** — `SectionLayer_ABBelowV2` (below terrain + things + air mask + fog) · **`SectionLayer_ABMountainCap`** (sky-band mountain mass, printed with each rock's own linked atlas + vanilla corner fillers) · `ABMinedRockLookup` · `SectionLayer_ABBelowLighting` · `SectionLayer_ABBelowShadows` · `ABBelowDynamicDraw`.

**Interaction** — `Building_ABStairs2` (+ ladders) · `Building_ABAnchor` · `ABStairsOrders` · `ABBelowClickThrough` · `ABBelowMultiSelect` · `ABBelowOverlays` · `ABBelowSelectionDraw` · `ABBandView` · `ABBandJump` · `ABBandInput` · `ABUIGeometry`.

**Combat** — `ABCombatV2` · `ABCombatGeometry` · `ABCombatAcquisition`.

**Debug** — `ABV2Debug` · `ABDevTools.V2` / `.V2Spike` / `.V2Support`.

---

# 3. THE V1 DELETION — AND THE ONE THING IT BROKE

**`SectionLayer_ABMountainCap` (803 LOC) lived in `Source/Rendering/` but is LIVE V2 CODE.** Deleting the folder removed the sky band's mountain-mass rendering, and every capped cell fell through to the black air-mask backdrop. Restored to `Source/V2/`, V1 branches stripped, banded-only. Its `LevelSync` dependency was rescued as `ABMinedRockLookup`.

**The lesson: classify by BEHAVIOUR, not by directory.** `Section`'s constructor instantiates every `SectionLayer` subclass reflectively, so deleting one is **invisible to the compiler** — a green build proves nothing.

**The audit that should have run first**, and is the right check for any future prune:
1. Grep every candidate file for `ABBands` / `Banded` — the marker of "live on a banded map". (Two hits: this layer, and `LevelMapGen`'s now-moot interlock guard.)
2. Separately check every `SectionLayer` subclass, since those are auto-instantiated regardless of references. The other four (`ABBelowThings`, `ABCeiling`, `ABWallReveal`, `ABWallFacade`) all gate on `map.Level()`/`Levels()`/`UpperMap()` — null-or-zero without pocket maps — so they were genuinely inert.

Also rescued: `ABRockGen`/`ABOreGen` → `ABRockOreGen.cs`; `ClearCell`/`Report` → `ABDevTools.V2Support.cs` (`ABDevTools` was a **partial class** split across V1 and V2).

---

# 4. MEASURED PERFORMANCE

Profiling via **Modern Dev Suite** (`astryl.ModernDevSuite`), driven over its loopback API at `127.0.0.1:8787` (`POST /api/v1/commands` with `startRun`/`stopRun`). Runs land in `<savedata>/ModernDevSuite/Runs/*.json`. Only **Run full sweep** (Live tab) needs a human.

### Verified before → after (2000-frame windows)
| Metric | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Total mod cost | **3,791 ms** | **740.9 ms** (−80.5%) |
| Patch count | 58 | 22 |
| `OverlayDrawer.DrawAllOverlays` postfix | **1.406 ms/frame** | **0.00116 ms/frame** (−99.9%) |
| V1 hot-getter patches | 5 live | all gone |

**The big win:** the forbidden-overlay postfix swept EVERY cell of the translated view rect with a `ThingsListAtFast` per open-air cell. It now iterates vanilla's own `OverlayDrawer.overlayHandles` dict (which `DrawAllOverlays` never clears, so a postfix reads it safely).

### Partial win — and a mistake worth remembering
The wormhole re-arm went 0.339 → **0.266 ms/frame (prefix 0.135 + postfix 0.131)**, only −22%, because gating it **added a second Harmony patch to a method called ~4,500×/frame**. The remaining cost is *dispatch*, not work. **Better fix: subscribe to `map.events.Notify_RegionsRoomsChanged`** (fires exactly when a rebuild completes) and stop patching `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` at all.

### Measured NOT to be a problem
`SectionLayer_ABBelowV2.Regenerate` — all below terrain, edge fades and things — costs **~0.9 µs/call**. Stripping below-layers from basement/gutter sections is a **memory-only** win, not a frame-time one.

### Measurement traps (each cost a wrong conclusion)
- **Nested instrumentation inflates outer timings.** A run arming 227 methods reported `ABBelowV2.Regenerate` 154× higher than one arming 29. Use a low-target run for layer cost, a high-target run for attribution; never compare absolute costs across differently-armed runs.
- **Vanilla's `SectionLayer_LightingOverlay` still BAKES on banded maps** (~3.92 ms/2000 frames) despite our `Visible` suppression — `Section.TryUpdate` does not check `Visible`; only `RegenerateDirtyLayers` does. **Open fix:** prefix its `Regenerate` to no-op on banded maps.
- **Benchmark sampling must happen OUTSIDE the stopwatch.** See §5.

### Throttling: already free
`Section.TryUpdate(view)` does **not** regenerate dirty layers for sections outside the camera view — it latches `anyLayerDirty`, clears `dirtyFlags`, and defers regeneration to `DrawSection()` when the section comes into view. Bands you aren't looking at already cost ~zero mesh regeneration. Do NOT build a band-visibility throttle; it would need a global "current band" latch, the anti-pattern that made V1 unmaintainable.

---

# 5. PATHFINDING — THE HANDOFF'S #1 QUESTION, PARTLY ANSWERED

With MDS's stress sampling fixed (standable cells + divide by *effective* iterations):

| Scenario | Banded | Vanilla control | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ai.pathfind` | **616.9 µs/path** (186/200 found) | 944.6 µs/path | **0.65× — no per-path blowup** |
| `ai.reachability` | 2.06 µs | 0.393 µs | contaminated, see below |
| `world.regions` | 0.755 µs | 0.071 µs | contaminated, see below |

**The feared 3× per-path regression does not exist.** Previously this read 35 µs/path off 8/200 successes — a meaningless number that looked like a 27× *speedup*.

**Two caveats, both important:**
1. This measures path **requests**. `PathGridJob` is the *grid rebuild* (IJobParallelFor over all cells) — a different cost this scenario does not isolate. The doc's specific concern is still open.
2. **The reachability and region numbers are NOT yet trustworthy.** The `TryRandomStandable` retry loop runs *inside* the timed section; on a banded map only ~26% of cells are standable (~4 retries) vs ~95% on vanilla (~1 retry). For `world.regions`, whose real work is ~0.07 µs, the sampling dominates entirely. **Fix: pre-generate cell pairs before starting the stopwatch.**

---

# 6. ENGINE LESSONS

1. **`dontRender` terrain silently suppresses shadows** (`SectionLayer_Terrain` swaps in `MatBases.ShadowMask`).
2. **Terrain shaders use world-position UVs.** Build terrain quads by hand.
3. **Never depend on `PatherArrived` firing at an exact cell.** Use a per-tick position sweep.
4. **Never `Clear` a transit record on same-band `StartPath`.** Records expire on a 4000-tick timeout.
5. **Aiming uses `Face`/`FaceCell`, not `FaceTarget`.**
6. **Vanilla emits THREE sun-shadow skirts** (west/east/south) with DIFFERENT windings, no north skirt.
7. **Lighting: two complementary bakes cause vignetting** — one bake with the glow source substituted per cell is correct.
8. **A malformed `About.xml` silently DROPS a mod** — RimWorld logs `XmlException: Data at the root level is invalid`, falls back to default metadata, and the packageId then fails to match ModsConfig. No "failed to find mod" error; the mod is simply absent. Check the log's first 30 lines when a companion mod mysteriously isn't loaded.
9. Misc: `menuHidden` doesn't exist on ThingDef · geysers are `destroyable=false` (DeSpawn, don't Destroy) · `GenStep_Fog` fogs the whole map · `GenRadial` caps at ~79.8 · `MapDrawLayer.map` is private, use `SectionLayer.section`.

**PROCESS LESSON: measuring beat reasoning every single time.** Pre-measurement the suspected hot spots were the see-below layers; measurement showed they were nearly free and the cost was an overlay sweep and a re-arm postfix nobody suspected. Also: **emit ONE self-contained log message per event** — separate `Log` calls from one helper share a stack signature and get folded by the monitor.

---

# 7. OPEN WORK

### Bugs
- **COMBAT (highest priority).** Cross-band shots: pawn "fires straight down", projectile doesn't hit. **Two separate problems**, previously conflated: (a) the *visual* — `ABBelowDynamicDraw` iterates `map.mapPawns.AllPawnsSpawned` only, so projectiles in the band below are confirmed never drawn from above; (b) the *hit* — impact resolves in `Projectile.Tick`/`ImpactSomething`, independent of draw, so fixing (a) will make it look right while still missing.
- **Colonists sometimes don't spawn on generation.** Unconfirmed.

### Perf (next, in order)
1. Replace the `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` prefix+postfix with a `Notify_RegionsRoomsChanged` subscription (−0.27 ms/frame).
2. No-op vanilla's `SectionLayer_LightingOverlay.Regenerate` on banded maps (−3.92 ms/2000 frames).
3. Move MDS's benchmark sampling outside the stopwatch, then re-measure reachability/regions.
4. Isolate `PathGridJob` grid-rebuild cost specifically.
5. Map generation is ~3× slower (vanilla generates over the whole tall map, then bands are carved).
6. Compat audit not started: MissileGirl, PrePatcher, Faster Game Loading, Performance Esmolas, Performance Optimizer, Clean Pathfinding 2, Kingfisher.

### Deferred features
- **Transplant** (generate a normal map at full fidelity, move it into band 1) — fixes the coastline caveat (**use inland tiles for now**), save migration, true-lazy banding.
- Turret cross-band targeting · drafted move ghost · per-band biome consumers · sky richness · cliff-face wall facades.

### `ABBandEnv` — read before touching biomes
V2's one genuine regression vs V1: `Map.Biome` is get-only and derived from the world tile, so per-band biome must be fed to each consumer explicitly (done for `WildPlantSpawner` density, `GenTemperature`, two `CellFinder` edge-cell patches). **A contextual `map.Biome` getter driven by an ambient "current cell" latch is DELIBERATELY REJECTED** — it is the lying-to-vanilla-behind-a-global-latch pattern that made V1 unmaintainable.

---

# 8. PUBLISHING STATE

Disconnected from the original upload: `About/PublishedFileId.txt` deleted, renamed **"As above, So below II"**, packageId **`astryl.AsAboveSoBelow2`**, `incompatibleWith` the original.

**⚠ BEFORE PUBLISHING:**
1. **`About.xml` `<description>` is still V1's** and makes **false functional claims** — it promises elevators, vertical conduit/water/duct/chem shafts, psycast cross-level targeting, caravans, Hospitality guest tours, trader airships and "zero recurring cost until you build a level", none of which exist in V2. A store-page accuracy problem, not a copy edit. User-owned text.
2. `About/known-issues.json` is V1's (18 shipped issues, all V1).
3. `ARCHITECTURE.md` and `docs/HELICOPTER_VIEW.md` describe V1.

## Settings
Map size capped at **200×200**; a toggle unlocks it behind a bold red performance warning. Enforced twice — chooser AND generation.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true` always. Companions: **`astryl.ModernDevSuite`** + `astryl.ModernDevTools`. Palette pins get culled for Playing-gated debug actions — use the Debug Actions menu. **Banding happens at generation ⇒ needs a NEW colony** (quicktest qualifies). Map gen is ~3× slower — expected, not a hang. **Use inland tiles until transplant lands.**
